notes.title: Memory Lost: Chapter One Receives Huge Content Update!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce a massive update to Memory Lost: Chapter One! [b]You can now play the entire first chapter of the full game[/b] by heading to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129490/Memory_Lost_Chapter_One/]Memory Lost: Chapter One [/url][/b] and jumping straight into the fresh, updated gameplay and seeing what’s in store for the full launch next year!

[previewyoutube=rvGlwLCvWfc;full][/previewyoutube]

The [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2129490/Memory_Lost_Chapter_One/]Memory Lost: Chapter One [/url][/b] was first launched in December 2022 and has delighted shooter fans with its innovative combat mechanics and fast-paced gameplay. Over the past 12 months, we’ve been gathering community and players feedback to support the ongoing development of the full game. As part of the continued development journey of Memory Lost, we will continue to use the valuable feedback gathered from the Memory Lost: Chapter One to enhance the full game experience.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1483190/Memory_Lost/

Try Chapter One for free and wishlist Memory Lost!

notes.title: TETRAGON RECEIVED RELEASE DATE
notes.notes:
Friends, fans of puzzles, secrets and mysterious worlds!

We are pleased to announce that the dizzying anti-gravity adventure [b]Tetragon [/b] has received a release date - 12 August!

An amazing story about the adventures of a simple lumberjack Lucius, traveling across picturesque square worlds in search of his son, who suddenly disappeared under mysterious circumstances, is about to become available to everyone.

[previewyoutube=42fcJfiuFBg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Do not forget to add the game to your wishlist and please all your friends with this wonderful news:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545850/Tetragon/
[h2]You can also try out the game right now as part of a free demo![/h2]

New patch already available!

1.01 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Comrades, first patch for the cult classic arrived! All changes:

1. Fixed the issue, when Petka tries to give the Vudu doll to Furmanov.
2. Fixed the issue with main menu after players finished the game.
3. Fixed the issue with inventory items and main characters.
4. Fixed the issue when finding one item in inventory.
5. Fixed volume problem.
6. Hints will not disappear now.
7. Improved overall stability.
8. Fixed minor errors.

Thank you for your patience, wishes and comments!
